system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You have learned to harness your Manic state into one that can be focused and targeted. In the moments before losing yourself to your mania, you can focus on a single target, instead of lashing out wildly. Once per short rest, when you become Manic, you can select one creature you can see as your Marked Prey. This creature becomes your Priority Target while Manic and cannot be changed. While this creature is marked in this way, you must maintain concentration on them, as if concentrating on an S-Rank jutsu. This mark lasts until the target is reduced to 0 hit points or you lose concentration.

Also, this focus has unlocked additional ways to spend your Nature Energy. You gain the following additional expenditures:

Savage Intimidation. As a Bonus action, by spending 2 Nature Energy, select your Priority Target, if they are within 60 feet of you. You release an alluring pulse of nature energy, attempting to trick their bodies instincts, forcing them to move closer. They must make a Wisdom saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failure, they must spend their Reaction, and then move up to their movement speed towards you. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity from creatures other than yourself.

Rejuvenating Siphon. When a hostile creature scores a critical hit against you, you can spend 4 Nature Energy, to select up to 4 of the highest rolled damage dice by the hostile creature. Those dice are removed from their damage result and you gain hit points equal to twice the result of the rolled dice.

Natures Verdict. If you score a critical hit against your Priority Target, while Manic, as a result of an Action you took, you can spend 6 Nature Energy. If you do, you gain an additional action which you can use to repeat the same action used to score the critical hit.
